title: Deliver Coal to Mindtown Power Station
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Coal** delivered to **Mindtown Power Station** (industry id 1, near tile 229,32).

A likely supplier is **Faningwell Coal Mine** (industry id 0, near tile 214,62); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **680 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
